newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: EU's Brittan meets trade body chief in Geneva.
newsitem.headline: EU's Brittan meets trade body chief in Geneva.

text.p: European Union (EU) Trade Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan broke off from bilateral telecoms talks in Geneva to hold an unscheduled session with the World Trade Organisation (WTO) chief in what diplomats said was a sign of continuing problems.

Brittan made no comment as he went in to meet WTO Director General Renato Ruggiero, who has made a telecoms deal his top priority and argues that it will also give a major impetus to development in the world's poorest countries.
The meeting lasted for about an hour after which Brittan was scheduled to hold a news briefing.

Trade negotiators said the fate of a global pact to open up basic telecommunications to world-wide competition, which faces a deadline of midnight in Geneva (2300 GMT) on Saturday for completion, lay in the hands of the United States and a decision could come from Washington late on Friday.
A key meeting at the WTO to assess the state of talks was put back by five hours from 2.30 p.m. (1330 GMT) to 7.30 (1830 GMT) to give more time for the U.S. administration to consider its stance.
